description: Import the exact prior Fitch restricted-survivor certificate and retain its worlds, epistemic knowledge, atom and admissible family. Enlarge only modal accessibility to the universal relation, extending all old forward witnesses. The model has E inclusion in R and both S5 frames but actual ignorance. Compose the new collapse theorem to show the biconditional cannot hold. This witnesses a stipulated formal interpretation, not actual human knowledge or a blanket vindication of antirealism.
